items.title: Worthia "Showboy" Thomas Interview, 1961-12-11
items.q: I was his drunk player when he died. After he died, we played his funeral, funeral, buried him.

ctx.x: uh, yeah. Well I remember that. I remember that. But this particular lady, I don't think I know her. But I remember when uh, they had a little festival out on the boat. So you did get in on the quadrille dance and dance? I did. I did. Well, well, I stayed with John
Duncan, man seven years. How's that name spelled? Tunk? Tunkin. Tunkin. T-U-N-K-I-N-G.

He's originally from Alexander Louisiana. He was a band leader at 50 years. Oh really? I've heard the name but I don't remember for sure. Well, I was his drunk player when he died. After he died, we played his funeral, funeral, buried him. Then I came back to New Orleans.
